Card-face crop from [https://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=100680 Star Wars Collectors Archive item 100680], [https://theswca.com/imgup/100680-1.jpg source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(105, 105, 643, 841)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>9112a2afa1d013bd057f86e60ed30efaf06fc16205981b0ac49184e49fe78a7c</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
